label: 2M++ - published observation-derived reference
frame: Galactic Cartesian comoving axes; velocities in CMB frame
origin_definition: Local Group reference origin; Milky Way offset not supplied
uncertainty: Downloaded best-fit reference arrays provide no voxel posterior uncertainty; none is invented. Source paper parameter errors are not substituted for field uncertainties.
support: Model support is restricted to the stated200h^-1Mpc sphere. Source completion in survey gaps is predicted structure, not direct observations. No native survey-coverage mask is supplied here.
display_only: Native node decimation, not interpolation or a new fit; gaps remain invalid. Streamlines are instantaneous field geometry, not trajectories. No voxel posterior supplied.
